description: This file handles the deletion of a Campaign record in the SugarCRM-based system. It retrieves the current module, initializes a logger, verifies the deletion record parameter, performs the delete operation, and then redirects the user to a specified URL.

classes.name: CRMEntity

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to get an instance of CRMEntity for the specified module.
